title: Ennaval (என்னவள்)
overview: Ennaval a heart-touching musical expression of pure, unconditional love. This song is dedicated to that one special person who is not just a part of life but is life itself. She is the dream, the reality, the soul, and the entire universe. Crafted from the depths of emotion, "Ennaval" speaks the language of the heart for everyone who has found their "forever" in someone’s eyes.
